answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded harbor. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest beacon a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the nadir behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal k6faw.
